faqs.question: What counts as an active chatter?
faqs.answer: An active chatter is a unique user ID that sent or received at least one text chat message in your workspace during the billing month. Registered users who never open chat do not count. This lets consumer apps, marketplaces, and delivery platforms scale without being priced like internal team tools.

faqs.question: What counts as a text chat message?
faqs.answer: Text chat means written messages sent through the Sendsar API in channels and DMs. Each text message counts toward your monthly text chat allowance. Edits, system events, and webhooks do not. Text chat is separate from voice call and video call minutes.

faqs.question: What is the difference between text chat and calls?
faqs.answer: Text chat is asynchronous written messaging — you send and read text. Voice call and video call are live audio or video sessions with separate monthly limits. A text message never counts as call time.

faqs.question: What happens if we exceed included text chat messages?
faqs.answer: We pause new outbound text chat on that workspace until the next billing cycle or you upgrade. Voice call, video call, and call recording follow the monthly limits shown for your plan.

faqs.question: How do voice call, video call, and call recording minutes work?
faqs.answer: Voice call, video call, and call recording are live-session features — not text chat. Each plan includes separate monthly allowances for each type. On Free, you get 5 voice call minutes/month and 5 video call minutes/month; calls pause when either allowance is used up. Call recording is not included on Free.

faqs.question: What are concurrent connections and concurrent calls?
faqs.answer: Concurrent connections is the maximum simultaneous WebSocket connections for text chat in your workspace — an infrastructure guardrail, not a billing meter. Concurrent calls is the maximum active voice or video call sessions at once. Both protect shared infrastructure during peak traffic.

faqs.question: Can we save with annual billing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pay annually and save {discount}% on the base plan versus monthly billing — {plusYearlySavings}/year on Plus, {proYearlySavings}/year on Pro. Included text chat, voice call, video call, and call recording allowances are part of the base plan.

faqs.question: When should we talk to sales?
faqs.answer: Choose Enterprise when you need dedicated infrastructure, private cloud or self-hosted deployment in your region, custom webhook routing to CRMs or local SMS providers, custom voice and video call rates, or contract terms tailored to your organization.
